comment: Hand-written refusal/1 records. Each valid record must read, write back to the same JSON value and validate against refusal-record.schema.json; each invalid one must be refused by the reader and by the schema. `code` is the dotted text and never an index; `side` is one of plugin, suite, experiment, config, environment, candler; `path` and `file` are never both present, and a record may carry neither.

record.message: paths `plan.model` and `plan` overlap: one is the other or lies below it

valid.name: a file instead of a path

record.message: document is not readable (TOML parse error at line 1)

valid.name: neither a path nor a file

record.message: protocol 1.0 is not accepted by protocol 2.0 (upgrade the plug-in)

valid.name: the root of a document and several causes

record.message: suite entries depend on each other in a cycle (A -> B -> A)

valid.name: a key that holds a slash and a tilde

record.message: field path is not segments of `[a-z][a-z0-9_]*` joined by `.` (got "a/b~c")

invalid.name: code as a number
invalid.why: a code is the dotted text, never an index

invalid.name: code with no dot
invalid.why: the pattern needs a surface and a reason

invalid.name: code with an empty reason
invalid.why: every segment after the first needs a character

invalid.name: a side outside the six
invalid.why: side is plugin, suite, experiment, config, environment or candler

invalid.name: a side in capitals
invalid.why: sides are written in lower case

invalid.name: both a path and a file
invalid.why: a refusal locates itself in a document or in a file, not both

invalid.name: a path that is not a JSON pointer
invalid.why: RFC 6901 pointers are empty or start with a slash

invalid.name: a path with a bare tilde
invalid.why: a tilde is written ~0 and a slash ~1

invalid.name: a null path
invalid.why: an absent path is omitted, never null

invalid.name: causes holding a number
invalid.why: causes is a list of texts
